items.title: io.github.yuroyami:kitejs-rhino-macosarm64 0.5.0 发布, The Rhino JavaScript engine, ported to Kotlin Multiplatform, behind the KiteJS API. Runs ES5.1 and most of ES2015 and later, including classes, async functions, regular expressions, dates, typed arrays, promises, generators, Proxy and BigInt. The parser, the interpreter, the regular expression engine, the date arithmetic and the number formatting are all written in common Kotlin, so a script gives the same answer on Android, iOS, JVM, JavaScript, WebAssembly, Linux, macOS and Windows, with no native code at all.

io.github.yuku123:z-boot-fleet 1.0.4 发布, z-opc-foundation 兄弟仓 (z-config / z-cache / z-mq / z-gw / z-kb / z-vector / z-graph /
        z-rpc / z-oss / z-schedule / z-msg / z-script / z-ctc / z-util / L3 Agent-AI 7 仓) 的版本权威。
        与 z-boot-dependencies (第三方地板) 分家:抬任何一格兄弟仓版本只需要重发本 pom 一个文件夹,
        不牵动第三方地板。z-boot 自家的 z-boot-*-starter 不在这里 —— 它们只能和 z-boot 同版本,
        所以钉在 z-boot-parent。本文件由 _doc/003_script/gen_fleet_bom.py
        生成 —— 坐标清单取自兄弟仓盘上的 pom,版本逐件对 repo1 复核过,别手改。
